title: Teens Are Turning to Chatbots for Mental Health Help. We Need Rules to Keep Them Safe
summary_en: With social media, product adoption raced ahead while Congress debated causation and passed no meaningful national protections for children. With AI chatbots, we still have a chance to build something sturdier.
title_cn: Teens Are Turning to Chatbots for Mental Health Help. We Need Rules to Keep Them Safe
